channel.title: AIBuilder Marketplace — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched, honest software reviews: real pricing, the honest knock, who should skip it. No hype, no invented numbers.

item.title: Top Echelon Review (2026): From $89/mo, and the Catch
item.description: Top Echelon: $89 billed annually or $110 month-to-month on Professional. Almost everything people shop for sits in Professional, not Standard.

item.title: Pingtree Review (2026): What It Actually Costs
item.description: Pingtree — Self Managed: Startup $499/month, Starter $1,250/month and Growth $2,500/month. No overage rate is published on the pricing page.

item.title: ZenBusiness Review (2026): Real Pricing, Real Limits
item.description: ZenBusiness: Formation itself is $0 plus the state's fee. A registered agent is a legal requirement in every state, and theirs is $199/year.

item.title: Serpstat Review (2026): Per-Seat Pricing & the Catch
item.description: Serpstat: Individual $69/month, or $50 on annual billing. The thing you are actually buying is data coverage, and that is the one thing you cannot verify.

item.title: Seller Snap Review (2026): What It Actually Costs
item.description: Seller Snap — Starter: $100/month, annual billing only, for 1 marketplace, 1 user, 1,000 SKUs and $15,000 revenue.

item.title: Dripify Review (2026): What It Actually Costs
item.description: Dripify: Basic $39, Pro $59 and Advanced $79 per user per month billed annually, plus an Enterprise tier that is quote-only.

item.title: Retouch4me Review (2026): From $20/mo, and the Catch
item.description: Retouch4me: A July 2026 'high season sale' showed 30% off ($101.50/$125.30), time-boxed, not the list price. One plugin forever at $145 is honest value.

item.title: Zedonk Review (2026): From £166/mo, and the Catch
item.description: Zedonk: PLM £166/mo, ERP Essential £166/mo, B2C (adds Shopify integration and barcodes) £250/mo, B2B (adds the digital wholesale showroom) £332/mo.

item.title: SEO Space Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $18.99/mo
item.description: SEO Space: Starter, 1 site, $18.99/mo ($151.92/yr). Squarespace has been quietly absorbing the job this tool was invented for.

item.title: TextExpander Review (2026): No Free Tier — What You Pay
item.description: TextExpander: Individual $3.33 ($39.96/yr), Business $8.33 ($99.96/yr), Growth $10.83 ($129.96/yr), Enterprise quoted.

item.title: Cloudways Review (2026): From $11/mo, and the Catch
item.description: Cloudways: No free tier, but a 3-day free trial with no credit card required. "Fully managed" here means the server, not your site.

item.title: AltText.ai Review (2026): From $5/mo, and the Catch
item.description: AltText.ai: Credit-metered — one credit = one image. The headline ‘5¢ per image’ only holds for a plain JPG in one language.

item.title: Papaya Global Review (2026): What It Actually Costs
item.description: Papaya Global: Demo-led and opaque — no single price is confirmable. Every headline price is a 'starting from' that dead-ends at 'book a demo.

item.title: eDesk Review (2026): Free Tier & the Catch
item.description: eDesk: Free plan to start; Essential $39/agent/mo, Growth $89/agent/mo (Recommended), Professional $119/agent/mo, Enterprise custom.

item.title: involve.me Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $19/mo
item.description: involve.me: Free tier to start; Start $19/mo billed annually ($29 month-to-month) with 3 live funnels and 1 user.

item.title: Mktg.ai Review (2026): Real Pricing, Real Limits
item.description: Mktg.ai: No public pricing (verified 17 Jul 2026). The pricing is fully hidden — no tiers, no ranges, a 404 where the pricing page should be.

item.title: Buzz.ai Review (2026): Per-Seat Pricing & the Catch
item.description: Buzz.ai: A launch offer runs $75/mo for the first 3 months (and $75/mo per seat billed annually). Two meters run at once: seats AND credits.

item.title: ElevenLabs Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $6/mo
item.description: ElevenLabs: Free $0 with 10k credits/mo; Starter $6/mo (30k credits, commercial license); Creator $22/mo. Credits are the meter and retakes are the tax.

item.title: Deel Review (2026): What It Actually Costs
item.description: Deel: Contractors from $49 per contractor/month, or $325/month per Contractor of Record. Every price is a ‘starting at’ and every button says ‘book a demo’.

item.title: EngageBay Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $11.04/mo
item.description: EngageBay: $0 for 250 contacts with email marketing, CRM, helpdesk and live chat. The meter is contacts AND seats at once: prices are per user.

item.title: World Businesses for Sale Review (2026): Price & Limits
item.description: World Businesses for Sale: Browsing is free for buyers. On the broker plans you pay twice: a listing fee up front AND commission when it sells.

item.title: Alli AI Review (2026): From $299/mo, and the Catch
item.description: Alli AI: 10-day free trial, cancel anytime. The entry is $299 a month — agency-grade automation priced accordingly.

item.title: Convert Review (2026): What the Meter Really Costs
item.description: Convert: Growth $399/mo, or $299/mo paid annually ($3,588/yr), for 100K tested users a month. The meter is tested users, and it keeps running.

item.title: BillingNow Review (2026): From $9.99/mo, and the Catch
item.description: BillingNow: $9.99/mo for unlimited invoices, expenses and clients with an AI assistant, no tiers and no per-user fees. The pricing is genuinely refreshing.

item.title: Thordata Review (2026): What the Meter Really Costs
item.description: Thordata: Usage-metered, with free trials on the APIs. Everything is a meter — per GB, per IP, per 1K responses — so the bill scales with usage.

item.title: PagePulse Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo
item.description: PagePulse — Genuinely free tier: $0 for 1 member and 1 page with unlimited traffic. The tiers gate on two axes at once — members AND tracked pages.

item.title: Bread & Butter Review (2026): From $49/mo, and the Catch
item.description: Bread & Butter: AI Enabled Pro $49 per month PER WEBSITE. What stays dormant until someone submits an email is identity resolution.

item.title: Oneflow Review (2026): From €250/mo, and the Catch
item.description: Oneflow: Starting at €250/month, billed annually, with 5 users included. The entry is €250 a month on annual billing.

item.title: Team Pulse Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo
item.description: Team Pulse — Paid (billed annually): Starter $29/mo ($348/yr). The tiers gate on TWO axes at once — member count and project/pipeline count.

item.title: Moosend Review (2026): Annual Billing & the Real Cost
item.description: Moosend: 30-day free trial, no credit card. The friendly $7-9 headline is the entry rate at the smallest list size (500 contacts).
